Subject: Evaluation report
Date: Thursday 22 October 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Felix Arundel <felix.arundel@fenwicklabs.example.test>

Felix,

Plan for the evaluation report. I will send the draft on Monday 26 October and the final version on Monday 2 November after your comments.

If that is too tight, say so now rather than later.

Best,
Dom
